question: Build a trailing-twelve-month (TTM) comp table for four U.S. restaurant companies: Darden Restaurants, Brinker International, Cracker Barrel Old Country Store and The Cheesecake Factory. For each company compute TTM revenue (total revenues / net sales) and TTM GAAP net income attributable to the company, both in USD millions, through the company's most recent fiscal quarter reported as of October 3, 2026. Define TTM as the last four reported fiscal quarters, i.e. latest fiscal year + current fiscal year-to-date - prior-year year-to-date (when the most recent reported quarter is the fiscal fourth quarter, TTM equals that fiscal year); do not adjust for 52/53-week differences. State the TTM end date used for each company.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
TTM through each company's most recent reported quarter (USD millions):
| Row | TTM revenue | TTM net income |
|---|---|---|
| Darden Restaurants (TTM ended 2026-08-30) | 13,366.5 | 1,182.3 |
| Brinker International (TTM ended 2026-06-24) | 5,807.4 | 487.0 |
| Cracker Barrel Old Country Store (TTM ended 2026-07-31) | 3,318.7 | 31.7 |
| The Cheesecake Factory (TTM ended 2026-06-30) | 3,877.3 | 178.6 |

output.answer:
# TTM Comp Table — U.S. Restaurant Companies (as of October 3, 2026)

All figures in USD millions, GAAP, through each company's most recent reported fiscal quarter. TTM = latest fiscal year + current fiscal-year-to-date − prior-year fiscal-year-to-date (no 52/53-week adjustment).

| Company (Ticker) | TTM End Date | TTM Revenue | TTM Net Income (attrib. to company) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Darden Restaurants (DRI) | Aug 30, 2026 | $13,366.5 | $1,182.3 |
| Brinker International (EAT) | Jun 24, 2026 | $5,807.4 | $487.0 |
| Cracker Barrel Old Country Store (CBRL) | Jul 31, 2026 | $3,318.7 | $31.7 |
| The Cheesecake Factory (CAKE) | Jun 30, 2026 | $3,877.3 | $178.6 |

## Calculation detail

**Darden Restaurants** — Most recent quarter: Q1 FY2027, ended 8/30/2026. TTM = FY2026 + Q1 FY2027 − Q1 FY2026.
- Revenue: 13,210.9 + 3,200.3 − 3,044.7 = **13,366.5**
- Net earnings: 1,206.7 + 233.4 − 257.8 = **1,182.3**
- (FY2026 was a 53-week year; no adjustment made per instructions.)

**Brinker International** — Most recent quarter reported is Q4 FY2026, ended 6/24/2026, so TTM = FY2026.
- Revenue: **5,807.4**; Net income: **487.0**

**Cracker Barrel** — Most recent quarter is Q4 FY2026, ended 7/31/2026, so TTM = FY2026.
- Revenue: **3,318.7**; GAAP net income: **31.7** (impacted by MSBC divestiture loss and impairment charges)

**The Cheesecake Factory** — Most recent quarter: Q2 FY2026, ended 6/30/2026. TTM = FY2025 + H1 FY2026 − H1 FY2025.
- Revenue: 3,751.8 + (978.8 + 1,029.6) − (927.2 + 955.8) = 3,751.8 + 2,008.5 − 1,883.0 = **3,877.3**
- Net income: 148.4 + (49.5 + 68.4) − (32.9 + 54.8) = 148.4 + 117.9 − 87.8 = **178.6**

## Notes
- Only Brinker and Cracker Barrel had already reported their fiscal fourth quarter by 10/3/2026, so their TTM equals the completed fiscal year. Darden (FYE May) and Cheesecake Factory (FYE December) required the roll-forward formula.
- GAAP net income is presented as reported (including discontinued operations where applicable); no non-GAAP/adjusted figures or noncontrolling-interest adjustments were applied.
- Sources: Darden Q1 FY2027 release (prnewswire.com; sec.gov 10-Q), Darden FY2026 release (prnewswire.com/sec.gov); Brinker FY2026 release (investors.brinker.com; sec.gov 10-K); Cracker Barrel FY2026 release (prnewswire.com; sec.gov 10-K); Cheesecake Factory Q1/Q2 FY2026 and FY2025 results (businesswire.com; sec.gov 10-Q/10-K).
